system.description:
Terror Cloak of Skulls: Spells targeting Skulltaker suffer Hellblade: Skulltaker carries a jagged black blade with Pierce 1 and CR 2 AGGRESSION CUNNING

You burn the flesh from the skull of a defeated foe, claiming another skull for the skull throne. All followers of Khorne within medium range gain the Inspired condition, and all enemies within medium range gain the Demoralised condition. One follower of Khorne within medium range gains the Frenzied condition. Engaged with the body of a recently-fallen foe, targets them in medium range. § Recover 1 wound
